population_estimate.label: Population (estimate)
population_estimate.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
population_estimate.note: Estimated residents on July 1 of each year. Modeled from the 2020 Census plus births, deaths and migration; each new vintage revises earlier years.

pop_change_pct.label: Population change since 2020
pop_change_pct.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
pop_change_pct.note: Percent change from the April 1, 2020 estimates base to July 1 of each year. The base is the 2020 Census count adjusted by the Census Bureau, not the raw count.

natural_change_rate.label: Births minus deaths, per 1,000 people
natural_change_rate.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
natural_change_rate.note: Births minus deaths. Summed from April 1, 2020 to July 1, 2025, per 1,000 residents in the April 2020 estimates base. These are modeled estimates, not counts, and each new vintage revises every year back to 2020.

net_international_migration_rate.label: Net international migration, per 1,000 people
net_international_migration_rate.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
net_international_migration_rate.note: People moving in from abroad minus people moving abroad. Summed from April 1, 2020 to July 1, 2025, per 1,000 residents in the April 2020 estimates base. These are modeled estimates, not counts, and each new vintage revises every year back to 2020.

net_domestic_migration_rate.label: Net moves from other U.S. counties, per 1,000 people
net_domestic_migration_rate.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
net_domestic_migration_rate.note: People moving in from other U.S. counties minus people moving out to them. Summed from April 1, 2020 to July 1, 2025, per 1,000 residents in the April 2020 estimates base. These are modeled estimates, not counts, and each new vintage revises every year back to 2020.
